fields.description: Filtered to Approved timesheets against the parent's Contract and Service Month/Year.
fields.label: Timesheet

fields.description: The specific vehicle within that timesheet this line is for.
fields.label: Equipment

fields.description: For Daily/Yearly/Hourly billing: the contract's own UOM, carried onto the Purchase Receipt as-is. For Monthly billing: always Hour (Quantity is hours worked) — the Purchase Receipt instead uses a Month-based UOM and quantity, not this row's own.
fields.label: UOM

fields.description: The contract's billing frequency for this equipment — what Quantity is converted to (e.g. 31 worked days on a Monthly contract becomes 1). Not the same as UOM: this drives the day conversion, UOM is the Purchase Receipt's unit.
fields.label: Billing Frequency

fields.description: The contract's own rate for this equipment.
fields.label: Rate

fields.description: From the timesheet row — this equipment's Normal Hours for the period.
fields.label: Normal Hrs

fields.description: From the timesheet row — this equipment's Overtime Hours for the period.
fields.label: OT Hrs

fields.description: From the timesheet row — this equipment's Breakdown Hours for the period.
fields.label: BD Hrs

fields.description: Number of days this equipment actually has hours logged, within the timesheet's own period.
fields.label: Days Worked

fields.description: For Daily/Yearly/Hourly billing: Days Worked converted to the contract's own UOM (e.g. 31 worked days on a Yearly contract becomes a fraction of a year). For Monthly billing: this equipment's total working hours (Normal + OT) instead — the Purchase Receipt is what converts that into a month fraction, using the contract's daily hour threshold.
fields.label: Quantity

fields.description: For Monthly billing: Normal Hours × Rate (Overtime is billed separately below, at its own rate). For Daily/Yearly/Hourly billing: Quantity × Rate.
fields.label: Amount

fields.description: Entered by the user — there's no OT rate on the contract to fetch, since normal running is billed monthly but overtime is paid separately.
fields.label: OT Rate

fields.description: Fetched from the timesheet's own Deduction Amount for this equipment.
fields.label: Deduction

fields.description: Amount + OT Amount - Deduction. This is what VAT is based on, not Amount alone. Rolled up onto the header's own Net Amount, which the Purchase Receipt fetches as a header-level figure (custom_net_amount) — the Purchase Receipt's own line item is Amount x Quantity only, not this.
fields.label: Net Amount
